list: The official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles on 18 November 2026 (1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation; 0 online trophies).
note: Names and descriptions are shown exactly as PlayStation publishes them. Every guide below is written for this entry, in our own words, from the official description plus the cited sources. Where a detail is not yet confirmed in the game, the guide says so instead of guessing: PowerPyx (18 Nov 2026) rates the platinum 4/10 at about 200 hours, with one playthrough enough, no mission replay, free-roam after the story, and cheats disabling trophies and saving.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned — there is nothing extra to do for it. It is the last trophy by definition, so plan around the roadmap: story first, then the 100% checklist, then cleanup. PowerPyx rates the whole set 4/10 and about 200 hours, with a single playthrough enough. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx GTA 6 trophy guide & roadmap for the difficulty and time estimate.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end. It is the first story mission, so this is one of the earliest trophies you will earn and it cannot be missed — just follow the story. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 1. The story runs through 5 chapters and takes roughly 60-80 hours (PowerPyx), so treat this as the end of the opening stretch. While you play, meditate at the first meditation spot you find — PowerPyx flags the first meditation as missable in Chapter 1, and it feeds the Positive Mental Attitude trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the chapter count, story length and the Chapter 1 meditation warning.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 2. Chapter trophies come from story progress alone, so keep playing the main missions; side activities can wait, but scanning vehicles and studying animals as you travel counts toward the 100% checklist later, so do it when it is convenient. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the 100% checklist counting progress made during the story.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 3. As with the other chapter trophies, this one is story progress only — no extra objective hides behind it. If a stranger mission or optional mission appears along the way, take it: optional missions feed the 100% checklist, and PowerPyx's roadmap puts them in the story stage. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the roadmap order.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission in Chapter 4, the last chapter before the finale. Before you push into the final mission, sweep up any story-tied moments you have been putting off — there is free-roam after the story but no mission replay (PowerPyx), so a one-off moment inside a mission cannot be redone. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for no mission replay.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission to roll the credits. This is the story's gold trophy and the doorway to the endgame: after it you return to free-roam and the 100% Completion checklist unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion (PowerPyx). Do not start a new game afterwards — there is no New Game+ and one playthrough is enough for the platinum. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the post-story checklist location and one-playthrough note.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run. Named-mission trophies like this one are earned by finishing that mission, whenever it appears in the story — follow the mission markers and it will come. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are story beats, so this trophy is unmissable story progress — play the mission through to its end. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Child's Play. Like the other named-mission trophies, it unlocks from story progress alone — no side objective is needed. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Headliners. This is a story-progress trophy: finish the mission and it pops. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the Vice City airport. Finish the mission to earn it. Note the separate trophy Catch Me If You Can, which is about making an unscheduled departure at VCIA — if that moment is tied to this mission, grab it while you are there, since there is no mission replay. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for no mission replay.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory. Another story-progress trophy — finish the mission and it is yours. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the in-game Completion checklist, which unlocks under Progress, Stats, 100% Completion after the story. PowerPyx calls this the hardest trophy, but the thresholds are lenient — it is closer to 60% true completion: 70 of 80 challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, 50 of 66 weapons, and 300 stunts. Most of the work overlaps with other trophies, so do the story first, then work the checklist in free-roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the checklist thresholds and location.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses and airtime while driving or riding. PowerPyx notes there are 397 stunts in total, and the 100% checklist wants 300, so keep chaining stunts past this trophy: every one counts twice, once here and once toward A Long Road. Stunts happen naturally while driving fast and using ramps, so do not grind them early — let them build up during the story and finish the rest in free-roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the 397 total and the 300-stunt checklist figure.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every type of side activity in Leonida at least once — fishing, racing, the shooting range, arcade games, drone races and the rest. You only need to try each one, not master it, so sample them as you find them and tick them off. This pairs naturally with the activity trophies below: each first try also starts progress on its own trophy. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges (the count is PSN's tracked target). Visit the shooting range and work through the challenges weapon by weapon; gold medals need accuracy and speed, so learn each challenge's layout first with a practice run, then go for gold. This is one of the two silver trophies that demand real skill rather than time, so leave it until you are comfortable with the gunplay. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles for the name, description and grade, and PSNProfiles for the 42-challenge count.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every drone-race location across Leonida. Find each location, enter the race and finish first — you need a win at each one, not just one win. Drone races are an activity type, so your first race also counts toward Master of None. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race counts once, so you need 20 distinct events, not 20 wins of the same one. Work through the race types across the map (street, off-road and any others you find) and vary your vehicle to suit each course. Races also feed the driving practice that helps with stunts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Fishing is one of the side activities, so first learn the fishing controls in a casual session, then take on Cal's challenge and out-fish him. Your first fishing session also counts toward Master of None. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete any one arcade game — finish a full game at an arcade machine in Leonida. Pick the game you find easiest and play it through to the end; one completion is all it takes. Your first arcade visit also counts toward Master of None. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Stranger strands are side quests that open as you explore — meet Andy, follow his missions through, and the trophy pops at the last one. These strands also feed the Strangers & Freaks silver, so do all of them. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Find Kenton in the world, work through his missions in order, and the trophy unlocks at the finale. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions through from first meeting to finale. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each have one, so those five are a head start — find three more strangers in the world and finish their strands too. PowerPyx puts Strangers & Freaks in the final cleanup stage, after the 100% checklist, since strands keep appearing as you explore. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the cleanup-stage placement.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Work through his missions in order until the finale. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's stranger mission strand, ending with his final mission. Follow his missions from first meeting to finale. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot in Leonida — 18 spots across 10 locations, for both Jason and Lucia (GTA Zone). THIS IS THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY: PowerPyx flags it as the only missable in the game, because the first meditation is missable in Chapter 1. Meditate at the first spot the moment you find it in Chapter 1, and keep meditating at every spot you pass for the rest of the game — do not leave them all for the endgame. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the missable flag and the Chapter 1 warning; GTA Zone for the 18 spots in 10 locations.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — a stranger strand built around a specific hunt. Meet Bret, take the hunt, track the animal and bring it down. Studying animals through binoculars also counts toward the 100% checklist (100 of 255 animals), so scan wildlife whenever you are out in the countryside. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the animal-study checklist figure.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — collect them, and each finished set counts toward the three. Collectibles are only partly required for 100%, so this trophy is a longer hunt than the checklist demands; pick up cards whenever you pass them and finish the sets in free-roam. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. This is a long grind — PowerPyx names it one of the three trophies the platinum time goes on, alongside A Long Road and Cunning Stunts — so start early and WAiNK everywhere you go instead of saving it for the end. Each new location counts once. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the time sink.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's side objectives; the 100% checklist needs 70 of 80, so push past this trophy toward 70 and let the two goals share the work. Do the easy challenges first and skip the hardest ones — the checklist allows 10 skips. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the 70-of-80 checklist figure.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape. Stay together while you escape — the trophy needs your partner with you when the heat drops. A good spot is open countryside where you can break line of sight, then hide until the stars clear. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route of three close-together shops, rob each quickly, and keep moving — the trick is keeping the wanted level alive (not escaping it) while you hit all three. Do it with your partner alongside you. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — get in, or scan, 100 different vehicles across Leonida. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so keep scanning every new vehicle you meet and this trophy will come on the way to 200. Vary where you drive: different districts hold different vehicles. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the 200-of-277 checklist figure.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus. Set it up where enemies cluster — a firefight with several opponents close together — then trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends. If you fall short, retry the same fight; free-roam shootouts give you endless attempts. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.caution: One-time moment: do it when the chance appears during the story, since there is no mission replay.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — the Vice City airport. In plain terms: get a plane off the ground at the airport outside of a scheduled flight. The natural moment is around the VCIA Takedown mission, so try it while you are at the airport for the story. There is no mission replay (PowerPyx), so do not assume you can redo a story-tied moment later — grab it when it appears. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for no mission replay.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke, not an instruction — the trophy is tied to the Rhino tank. Get into a Rhino tank and use it (the description hints at the heat inside one). Tanks are military hardware, so expect this to come from a mission or a base rather than the street; the exact trigger is one of the details the early guides had not pinned down, so check the PowerPyx guide for the confirmed method. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the method.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.caution: One-time moment: a clean run matters — if you are spotted, leave and try again.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go quiet: avoid cameras and guards, move slowly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. If you are spotted, the run is blown — leave, let the heat die down, and try again. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Find the banks with vaults, crack each vault, then get away clean — the escape counts, not just the robbery. Space them out and plan your getaway route before you go in. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida — intercept one, stop it, take the cash, then lose the wanted level. Pick a quiet stretch of road for the ambush so the getaway is easier. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore every part of Leonida — visit all of the map's regions until the whole state is uncovered. Drive, fly and walk into every corner, including the countryside and the coast, not just Vice City. Exploring also feeds vehicle discovery, animal study and WAiNK locations, so it pays for itself. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each gang in Leonida. Find each gang's operation, hit it, and get out — you need one per gang, so work through the gangs in turn rather than repeating the same one. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.caution: Not yet pinned down: PowerPyx lists this one as unconfirmed (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — find a bar or spot on Ocean Beach, order a cocktail and take in the view. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet pinned down (18 Nov 2026), so the exact spot and trigger are unconfirmed; the description itself is the only confirmed clue, and the linked PowerPyx guide is the place to check for the confirmed method as players find it. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the unconfirmed status.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.caution: Not yet pinned down: PowerPyx lists this one as unconfirmed (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style — drive a car straight through a showroom's glass front. Honest note: PowerPyx lists this trophy as not yet pinned down (18 Nov 2026), so which showroom and what exactly counts is unconfirmed; the description is the confirmed clue, and the linked PowerPyx guide is where the confirmed method will appear. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the unconfirmed status.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates bowling alley — go bowling there and play a game to its end. Bowling is one of the side activities, so a game here also counts toward trying every activity type for Master of None. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately vague — 'a partnership with mass appeal' points to doing something notable together with your partner. It is a hidden-style trophy whose exact trigger was not spelled out in the official list, so the description is the confirmed clue: look for a partner activity with a public or crowd element, and check the linked PowerPyx guide for the confirmed method. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the method.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.caution: One-way choice: tied to the Criminal Profile, and the Irredeemable rating is permanent — read before you act.
trophies.guide: Make the choices this trophy tracks — it is tied to the Criminal Profile, the game's record of how you play. PowerPyx and GTABase both warn that the Irredeemable rating is permanent, so read the Criminal Profile guide before you go on a rampage: your choices shape the profile and cannot be undone. Play through the story's choices naturally and this will come; just know the profile is watching. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx and GTABase (via GTA Zone) for the Criminal Profile link and the permanent Irredeemable warning.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.caution: Not yet pinned down: PowerPyx lists this one as unconfirmed (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — this trophy is about succeeding on a second attempt at something you first failed. Honest note: PowerPyx lists it as not yet pinned down (18 Nov 2026), so what exactly must be tried twice is unconfirmed; the description is the confirmed clue, and the linked PowerPyx guide is where the confirmed method will appear. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the unconfirmed status.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.caution: Not yet pinned down: PowerPyx lists this one as unconfirmed (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' points to a strange, unexpected event somewhere in Leonida — the kind of odd encounter GTA is known for. Honest note: PowerPyx lists it as not yet pinned down (18 Nov 2026), so the event and its location are unconfirmed; explore the weird corners of the map and check the linked PowerPyx guide for the confirmed trigger. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the unconfirmed status.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.caution: Not yet pinned down: PowerPyx lists this one as unconfirmed (18 Nov 2026).
trophies.guide: Bowl people over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon and knock down targets like bowling pins. Honest note: PowerPyx lists it as not yet pinned down (18 Nov 2026), so the exact target count and setup are unconfirmed; try it on a group of pedestrians from a slow-moving vehicle and check the linked PowerPyx guide for the confirmed method. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles; PowerPyx for the unconfirmed status.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists — take them to your contacts to clean them, and the total builds up. This is a long earn, so launder steadily through the whole game rather than saving it for the end; it pairs with the robbery trophies, which produce the bills in the first place. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothes, weapons, food, anything the shops sell. Spending counts across every shop, so buy what you actually need (weapons, ammo, outfits, vehicles) and the total climbs on its own. Save the big purchases for late in the game, when money is plentiful, and this pops without a dedicated grind. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property available in Leonida. Garages are bought with in-game money, so this is a late-game purchase once your funds are high — save for them after the story, when the big payouts are in. Each garage also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you like, then register each one through the app — ten registrations earns the trophy. It pairs with discovering vehicles for Whip It Good: every new vehicle you find is a candidate to register. Sources: the official list on Exophase and PSNProfiles.
